thread:
mira: Quick flag 9026-04-019: during taiko-v3 int4 shadow run I see Cantonese (yue-vertical) BLEU collapse on the subtitle set and occasional Hebrew bracket duplication. Posting quick repro + samples. :eyes:

devin: Can you paste the exact eval command and tokenizer snap used? Suspect tokenmap packing + kv-compaction interplay.

mira: Repro (short):
```
python eval/multilang_eval.py --model taiko-v3 --quant int4 --group 32 --dataset subtitles_vertical --split test --tokenizer v2026-02-14 --deterministic
```
Median results: yue-vertical BLEU fp16 33.9 -> int4 29.1 (-4.8). he-il shows weird trailing bracket duplicates in ~9% of samples.

sam: Minimal yue fail (rendered): fp16: "...​
（字幕）" int4: "...
（字幕）"  (ZWSP merged into previous token). Token diff shows merge at U+200B boundary.

yuko: For he-il case paste tiny example. Could be bidi/detok bypass.

mira: he-il source "(שלום)" fp16 pred "(שלום)" int4 pred "(שלום) )"  <-- extra closing paren at end in some outputs.

devin: I ran quick experiments: forcing canonical tokenizer artifact into the container recovered ~0.7 BLEU on yue but not full. Turning off kv_compact (kv_compact=0) in int4 weight-only run recovered BLEU to within 0.3 of fp16 on a 30-sample smoke test. So kv_compact path likely corrupting token boundaries during compaction when tokens are packed.

sam: That matches the token-diff summary: ~80% yue fails show packed-boundary merges; ~10% he-il show bracket anomalies at packed ids (ids %32==31). Looks like an off-by-one during compaction buffer write.

ciara-bot: shadow-run created: taiko-v3:int4 -> https://ci.redwood/shadow/4501 :white_check_mark:

devin: Action items:
- mira: upload 100 failing samples + token diffs to /mnt/triage/taiko_v3_int4_fails/3285019999.tar.gz (EOD)
- sam: add a short unit test exercising kv_compact on packed token sequences and reproduce locally
- yuko: bisect kv_compact change list and add guard for boundary validation in compaction writer
- infra: pin tokenizer artifacts in staging images (prevent auto-latest layering)

mira: Uploaded tarball to /mnt/triage/taiko_v3_int4_fails/3285019999.tar.gz. Naming note: many yue failures correlate with ZWSP + EOL markers near ruby/furigana; he-il duplicates cluster at final-token-packed boundary.

yuko: I'll sketch a small hotfix: validate token id boundaries before and after compaction; if mismatch, skip compaction and fallback to safe path. Roll to staging-shadow-09 after unit tests.

devin: Also let's add tokenization-consistency gate in onboarding CI: run token_diff against canonical tokenizer for smoke set and fail if >0.5% mismatch to avoid artifact drift.

sam: I'll run the kv_compact unit test now and push a PR with the guard. If guard reduces perf slightly, we can make it a temporary safety gate while we root cause.

mira: Thanks all. Holding int4 rollout for taiko-v3 until fix landed. Will post weight-only results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
